text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document out lines the 
 equipment inspection 
steps I1, required for
H.P mazot pump, which must be performed
on a monthly bases as indicated 
by M1 in the 
 above title block.
The first draft initiated by 
eng. Hesham M. Hassan, reviewed by director eng. Saad Mostafa, and revised by 
quality control eng. Samir Abdel Gelil at EDEPCo., accepted by general director eng. Ali Al-Lithy
and approved by eng. Mostafa Alam: Head Sector of Talkha Steam 
Power Station 2x210MW
Technical specification of these PUMP
No. of pump for every unit | 4 (PE31 , 32 , 33 , 34) D001
Pump type | Allweiler SMH 940
Delivered quantity (L/s) | 13.5
Max. pressure at pump inlet (Mpa) | 1
Max. pressure at pump outlet (Mpa ) | 4
Pump speed (rpm) | 1450
Recommended grease type | mobilux grease No.3
Equivalent grease type | Misr multi purpose grease R3
Re-lubricating time | Every one month
Shaft seal type | Mechanical seal
Bearing type | 6310C3Z
Set weight (Kg) | 780
Safety Precautions
A work order 
 must be issued, the maintenance staff should be qualified and carry the 
 suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area.
Wear safety 
 helmet, shoes.
Isolate the circuit breaker for the motor of this pump.
The pump must be isolated mechanically by closing suction and delivery
valve.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid,
 Feeler gauge.
Work
to be Carried Out
Before isolated the pump mechanically and electrically
Steps | Work to be carried out | Setting
 (reference value ) | Test results
1 | Check any noise or vibration in pump or motor. | OK NOT OK | 
2 | Check any leakage from the piping connections to the pump | OK NOT OK | 
3 | Check the amount of leakage from mechanical seal 
 and it must not more than 50 drop / min | <50 drop / min | 
4 | Check the bearing by using SPM | OK NOT OK | 
5 | Check the safety valve of the pump | OK NOT OK | 
6 | Check the pressure in the pumps delivery. | 3.8 Mpa | 
7 | Check the temperature of the bearing house. | < 80 C |

After isolated the pump mechanically and electrically
Steps | Work to be carried out | Setting
 (reference value ) | Test results
1 | Check the coupling and flexible part | OK NOT OK | 
2 | Check the mechanical seal if theres heavy leakage | OK NOT OK | 
3 | Re-grease ball bearing | OK NOT OK | 
4 | Check alignment between pump and motor. | OK NOT OK | 
5 | Retighten the bolts connected pump and motor with 
 foundation. | OK NOT OK | 
6 | Clean the pump | OK NOT OK |
